description:
v1.0 | 46 gates | 16 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

Adds two 8-bit numbers.

Use this to add two numbers in a creation, such as the sum in a calculator, a total on a score display, or the arithmetic inside a computer built from logic.

Feed it two binary numbers of the same width, lowest bit first. The sum comes out on the result outputs, and the carry output switches on when the sum does not fit. There is no carry input.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): a = x 0-7, b = x 8-15.
Outputs (green gates): result = x 0-7, carry = x 8.

Profile: small, the build with the fewest gates for this size.
How it works: One small cell per bit; the carry walks from bit to bit.
Checked on every possible input in a simulator. Gates include the input gates; ticks count the input gate too.
By: byggmesterPRO
